title: Biological signaling mechanism

intent.message: Ligand binding activates a receptor and its downstream cascade, and an inhibitor blocks the receptor step.

claims.statement: Ligand binding activates the receptor and the downstream phosphorylation cascade.
The inhibitor blocks the receptor step of the pathway.

expected_design_characteristics: Distinct activation and inhibition arrow conventions used consistently
A membrane or compartment cue that localizes the receptor step
Causal flow with a clear left-to-right reading path
Semantic colors resolved from the manuscript style rather than invented per figure
known_failure_modes: Inhibition drawn with the same arrow style as activation
Ambiguous compartment boundaries that hide where the receptor sits
Node shapes or colors drifting between equal-role entities
